newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Brazil to extend import exemptions to Mercosur.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to extend import exemptions to Mercosur.

text.p: Brazil's Finance Minister Pedro Malan said Wednesday that exemptions granted to Mercosur partners on import financing restrictions introduced by the country in March will be extended to Oct 31.
"We have decided that the exemptions to our Mercosur partners will be extended by 120 days from July 1," Malan told reporters during a Mercosur summit in Asuncion.
Brazil agreed to ease the rules of restrictions on import financing of less than a year for Mercosur after protests from fellow members Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay.

Malan said he did not think the measure had affected Mercosur trade. "In a little more than two months' operation of the exemptions...there has been a significant increase in intra-Mercosur trade," he said.
Brazil originally agreed to ease the rules until the end of July.
The rules allow imports of a value of less than $40,000 to be exempt from the financing restrictions.
